idea: Prevent engine-agnostic crews identity takeover by nested child processes spawned from ralph implementer/lens flows; same-engine codex->codex must be safe.

candidateDirections.name: Primary ralph spawn-env sanitization plus crews ancestry refusal defense-in-depth
candidateDirections.summary: Strip claimable CREWS identity vars at nested spawn boundaries in ralph (implementer + lens paths), and add engine-agnostic ancestry-based refusal in crews SessionStart/assign as backstop.

candidateDirections.name: Marker-only suppression via CREWS_SUPPRESS_CLAIM on nested children
candidateDirections.summary: Set a no-claim marker on child processes and short-circuit SessionStart claim when marker is present; lighter to ship but depends on perfect spawn-site coverage.

candidateDirections.name: Crews-only hardening around GAP1 live-owner checks
candidateDirections.summary: Avoid ralph edits and rely on stronger liveness/claim guards in crews; leaves source env leak intact and remains more race-sensitive.

questionsForSynthesis: Should CREWS_ENGINE be preserved or scrubbed in nested children when no role claim vars remain, to balance observability and safety?
Should ancestry refusal be scoped to member role only, or also apply to lead role claims for symmetry?
What minimum integration test matrix is required before landing (copilot->codex, codex->codex, brainstorm/plan lens fanout)?
Should marker-based suppression (D-002) still be added as tertiary defense after D-001, or omitted to keep semantics minimal?
